summary: Same-netlist control: layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json run with and without output_dbu_um on the current netlist. Flattened geometry is identical on all 29 layer/datatype pairs once the control is rescaled to dbu 0.00025 um. Layout geometry only; predictive PDK, nothing fabricated.

inputs.control_request: layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json with the output_dbu_um key removed
inputs.regen: python3 -I layout/pnr/regen.py, run in a scratch copy of the PR head

comparison.klt_diff: status: different. Not usable as the equivalence test here: klt diff never ignores the database unit (0.001 vs 0.00025) and the committed stream names its variant cells with a $VARn suffix that the control stream lacks.
comparison.method: klayout.db 0.30.12: flatten the top cell per layer/datatype, scale the control Region by control_dbu/committed_dbu, XOR against the committed Region
